pages.text: A Munchstone is an Arcane Gem formed from a black-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in an oval cut.$(br2)When activated, a Munchstone allows you to consume plant-blased blocks to restore your hunger and saturation. Charge is consumed for each point of hunger and each point of saturation recovered.

Please note that the Munchstone devours blocks that are in the world, it does not give you the idea to eat blocks that are in your inventory like conventional food.$(br2)Notably, you can use a Munchstone even if your stomach is full.
Munchstones can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
